variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.body: A scandal concerning {leader}, the leader of {party}, has come to light. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Leadership under an unwelcome spotlight
variants.body: The leader of {party}, {leader}, is the subject of a newly revealed scandal. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.body: A scandal about {leader}, leader of {party}, has become public. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
